records.issue_text: The !promResponse branch in GrafanaGroupLoader.tsx conflates query errors with 'no rule groups found', showing the informational alert instead of an error state when the prom query fails
records.rationale: In GrafanaGroupLoader.tsx the query result only destructures `{ data: promResponse, isLoading: isPromResponseLoading }` and there is no `error`/`isError` handling. The branch `if (!promResponse) { return (<Alert ... />); }` will be taken both when the prom query legitimately returns no data and when the query fails (data is undefined on error), so failures are not distinguished from “no data” and will show the same alert instead of an error-specific state.
